entities.summary: Dean Mathey was an American tennis player active in the early 20th century. Namesake of Mathey College at Princeton University, he was raised in Cranford, New Jersey and was a member of the Cranford Golf Club. He won the National Clay Court Tennis Doubles Championship twice.
